ruleCalibration.positive: Pay a PHP 1,500 registration and training fee today before starting.
ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: No application, training, or registration fee is required.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: A naive text match may flag a sentence that explicitly denies a fee. Negation handling must be tested.
Small organizations, student groups, and legitimate programs may use Gmail. The signal should prompt verification, not a verdict.

ruleCalibration.positive: Our company name and website will be shared after payment.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Forwarded posts may omit identity details even when the original listing contains them. Ask for verification before escalating.

ruleCalibration.positive: Students needed for easy online office work.
ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: The role includes writing test notes, checking assigned pages, and joining a weekly mentor call.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Short school posts may use broad role language because details are provided in an attached job description.

ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: The placement follows the school's 400-hour agreement; allowance details are confirmed by the placement office.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Compensation varies by location and program. The rule should consider unclear duties and guarantees, not a fixed amount alone.

ruleCalibration.positive: URGENT! Limited slots and instant hiring, no interview needed.
ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: Applications are open until September 30 and interviews are scheduled through the school placement form.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Real programs can have deadlines. The concern is pressure combined with missing verification or payment demands.

ruleCalibration.positive: Send your resume to our recruiter on WhatsApp only.
ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: Questions may be answered on Messenger, but applications go through the official school placement form.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Mentioning Messenger or WhatsApp is not enough by itself. The rule should detect exclusive hiring channels and missing official paths.

ruleCalibration.positive: Send your government ID, bank account details, and a selfie today.
ruleCalibration.nonTriggering: Submit only your resume and school endorsement during initial screening; no ID or bank details are needed.
ruleCalibration.falsePositiveRisk: Some legitimate onboarding processes request documents later. Timing and request context are essential.
